title: Ek beemaar se ae mujrayi sab ghar choota
body:
Ek beemaar se ae mujrayi sab ghar choota
Baap maa choote behen chooti baraadar choota
<<DIVIDER>>
Sheh se aye mujrayi abbase dilawar choota
pad gaya ghul ke baraadar se baraadar choota
<<DIVIDER>>
bole sheh hum sa na hoga koi awaara watan
qabr naana ki chuti shehr chuta ghar choota
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad bete bhala bhoolti banu kyu'n kar
baad athara baras ke ali akber choota
<<DIVIDER>>
deke abbas ko maida'n ki riza sheh ne kaha
baad muddat ke tera saath baraadar choota
<<DIVIDER>>
jab sakina ne suna mar gaye darya pe chacha
yaas paani se hui haath se saaghar choota
